meta.title: About
meta.description: Ofogh Zamin manufactures and supplies precision brass fittings and fluid-system components — built to recognised standards for reliable, leak-tight service.

hero.title: Precision brass fittings, built to spec
hero.subtitle: Ofogh Zamin designs, machines and supplies brass fittings and valves for water, gas and fluid systems — engineered for reliable, leak-tight performance.

story.title: Who we are
body: Ofogh Zamin is a manufacturer and supplier of precision brass fittings and fluid-system components. From compression and threaded fittings to ball valves and gas fittings, our range is built for the trades and industries that depend on dependable connections.
Every part is machined from quality brass to tight tolerances and finished to recognised standards, so the ten-thousandth fitting performs exactly as the first.

items.title: Built to standard
items.body: Fittings machined to recognised BSP and NPT standards for consistent, leak-tight joints.

items.title: Quality materials
items.body: Made from CW617N brass for strength, corrosion resistance and a clean finish.

items.title: Range & availability
items.body: A broad catalogue of sizes and types, supplied to spec for trade and industry.

items.title: Responsive supply
items.body: Straight answers on availability and pricing — tell us what you need and we'll respond.

cta.title: Looking for a specific fitting?
cta.subtitle: Browse the catalogue or send us your requirements — we'll help you find the right part.
